adminSite.miscNotifDelayHint: Delay between project changes before the e-mail notification is sent (ms). Applies on the next container cycle.
adminSite.miscPythonRunnerToggle: Enable the browser-based Python split editor for .py files (python-runner module).

ai_assistant_description: Ask questions about LaTeX, get help with errors, and more.
ai_prompts_desc: Customize the prompts and token budgets behind each AI feature. Leave a field empty to use the built-in default.
api_connection_desc: Enter the endpoint URL and API key for your OpenAI-compatible LLM provider.
ask_ai_action_help: Each template runs on the selected text. Use {{selection}} where the selected text should be inserted; if omitted, it is appended.
ask_ai_behavior_prompt_help: System prompt for the selection toolbar (Ask AI / paraphrase / rewrite).
compliance_disabled: The compliance review feature is disabled on this deployment.
compliance_inherited: Showing the deployment defaults. Edit anything or add a rubric and save to make this set your own.
compliance_no_rubrics: No review rubrics are configured for your profile yet. Add your own in your LLM settings (AI Settings → Compliance Review).
compliance_no_rubrics_user: No rubrics yet — the compliance review stays disabled until you add one.
compliance_review_desc: Review rubrics applied by the whole-document AI review ("Run review" in the AI Assistant rail).
compliance_rubrics_user_help: The compliance review checks your document against the rubrics below. These are yours, per profile — you can define the exact guidelines (numbered or bulleted requirements) and optional mechanical scan patterns. Until you save your own, you use the deployment defaults below.
compliance_saved: Your rubrics are saved and now personal.
configure_api_first: Configure the API connection above first
connection_failed: Connection failed — check URL and key
error_help_prompt_help: Instructions appended when a user clicks Ask AI about a compile error.
failed_to_link_dropbox: Failed to link project to Dropbox: {{error}}
feature_chat_help: The AI chat panel and Ask AI on selection.
grammar_checking_desc: Language and grammar feedback while you write. The per-project toggle lives in the project Settings modal.
grammar_picky_description: Also check style rules (passive voice, wordiness, fragments, ...). Turn off in a project if they are too aggressive.
kb_customize_card_hint: Rebind individual actions to your own keys (import / export as JSON).
kb_customize_desc: Rebind any action to your own keys. The defaults are the Overleaf bindings; "Current" is yours (empty = stock default). Custom bindings apply in the editor on top of whichever keymap you use (Overleaf / Vim / Emacs).
kb_reset_applied: Applied as your account default — the editor uses it on the next project load.
kb_scope_note: Saved account-wide; the editor applies it on the next project load (or right away for the active editor).
languagetool_disabled_by_admin: Disable LanguageTool for all users (force off)
languagetool_url_help: The URL of the self-hosted LanguageTool server (/v2 API), e.g. the internal Docker hostname + port. Blank = env fallbacks only.
llm_admin_description: Configure the AI assistant for your Overleaf instance. Set up the API connection, choose available models, and customize the system prompt.
llm_admin_from_env: Inherited from the LLM_API_URL environment variable. Saving here stores it in the admin settings file.
llm_all_features_disabled: AI features are currently disabled by the administrator.
llm_api_key_optional_local: Leave blank for a local server with no auth (e.g. a llama.cpp server).
llm_api_key_stored: An API key is already stored. Leave blank to keep it.
llm_byo_anthropic_hint: Uses api.anthropic.com unless you set a base URL.
llm_byo_compatible_hint: Any server with an OpenAI-style /v1 API: Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, OpenRouter, ...
llm_byo_delete_confirm: Delete this provider and its stored API key?
llm_byo_desc: Use your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, ...). Keys are encrypted on this server and used only for calls you start.
llm_byo_empty: You have no LLM providers yet. Add one below to chat, complete, and generate with your own keys.
llm_byo_err_completion: The completion model must be one of the listed models
llm_byo_err_models: Please add at least one model
llm_byo_err_url: A base URL is required for OpenAI-compatible providers
llm_byo_key_keep: Stored key present — leave blank to keep it
llm_byo_key_new: Your API key (left blank for keyless local servers)
llm_byo_models_note: The first model is the default for this provider. Highlighted model = inline completion.
llm_byo_openai_hint: Uses api.openai.com unless you set a base URL.
llm_byo_saved: Provider saved. It is now available in the editor.
llm_cfx_applied: Applied — recompile to see the result.
llm_cfx_apply_error: Could not apply the fix right now — please try again.
llm_cfx_apply_notfound: That text is no longer there — the line may have changed. Suggest a new fix.
llm_cfx_apply_readonly: You do not have edit rights on this project.
llm_cfx_footer: AI can make mistakes. Review fixes before you apply them.
llm_chat_confirm_clear: Click again to clear the conversation
llm_disabled_by_admin: Disable LLM for all users (force off, even BYO)
llm_features_desc: Enable or disable each AI feature for all users. A disabled feature cannot be used by anyone, even with their own API key.
llm_general_desc: Your own LLM providers and model selection (BYO key). Leave everything off to use the instance configuration only.
llm_generate_empty: The model returned an empty result — try again or check the model selection.
llm_generate_failed: Generation failed — the LLM service may be disabled.
llm_generate_hint: From the full content of this project:
llm_generate_working: Working on it — the model first reads the whole document…
llm_instance_allowuser: Allow users to bring their own API provider (BYO keys)
llm_instance_desc: Instance-wide LLM flags (was the /admin/site "LLM (instance)" tab). The master switch is read when the web service starts; rate limits and the BYO flag apply to new calls right away.
llm_instance_enabled: LLM features enabled (Ask AI, LLM grammar, review)
llm_section_help: Manage your LLM connections, your selected model and your compliance review rubrics. API keys are encrypted on this server.
llm_select_model_hint: This model is used everywhere — AI Assistant chat, Review, the AI Generate menu items and ask-AI on selected text. The choice is saved to your profile and follows you across projects.
llm_system_prompt_placeholder: You are a helpful LaTeX assistant...
llm_type_from_env: Inherited from the LLM_API_TYPE environment variable. Saving here stores it in the admin settings file.
llm_usage_desc: Token usage across the whole site (all users, site and personal connections). Data comes from real model responses and is updated after each request.
llm_usage_unavailable: Usage statistics are not available right now.
llm_user_settings_desc: Your personal AI assistant settings: your own API providers, grammar checking, review rubrics and token usage.
max_context_tokens_help: The context window (in tokens) of the review model, as configured on your backend. The review refuses documents that would not fit. No auto-detection.
model_selection_desc: Scan the API for available models, then choose which ones users can access.
review_busy: A review is already running. Please try again in a moment.
review_download_hint: Tip: download this report to keep it. Running a new review is a heavy operation for the server, so avoid repeating it unnecessarily.
review_empty: This project has no text to review.
review_failed: The review failed. Please try again.
review_max_tokens_help: Upper limit for the answer of each review pass. The actual room adapts to what the document leaves free inside Max context tokens, so a large value here never blocks a long document; it only allows more thorough per-requirement analyses when there is room.
review_model_unavailable: The review model is not available on the backend right now.
review_not_configured: The LLM backend is not configured. Contact your administrator.
review_not_found: The review was not found or has expired.
review_system_prompt_help: System prompt for the whole-document compliance review.
review_too_long: The document plus the room reserved for the answer does not fit the review model context window. Shorten the document, or ask your administrator to lower the review answer budget or raise the context window.
rubric_scan_patterns_help: "Label :: regex" (case-insensitive; a plain word works too). The reviewer scans the whole document for matches and only then asks the model to judge each hit — exhaustive mechanical checks plus contextual judgement for the pattern-like requirements of THIS rubric.
services_availability_desc: Force the AI or LanguageTool grammar checking off for every user, even when configured. LanguageTool needs a server URL (env fallback: LANGUAGE_TOOL_URL, or LANGUAGE_TOOL_HOST + PORT).
system_prompt_desc: This prompt is prepended to every AI conversation. Use it to customize the assistant's behavior for your organization.
